title: Maximum Value of K Coins From Piles
goal: Take exactly k coins from pile tops with the greatest total value.
strategy: Each pile offers only its prefix sums, since deeper coins require taking those above. DP combines one prefix choice per pile while marking impossible exact coin counts as unreachable.
